title: Settings
description: Server, compute, model, and environment settings
toast.languageSaveFailed: Failed to save the display language setting
toast.languageSaveFailedDescription: The interface was switched temporarily; it will revert to the server setting after a restart or refresh
toast.validationFailed: Validation failed. Fix the errors before saving
toast.saveFailedHint: Check the service status and try again
validation.port: Port must be an integer between 1 and 65535
validation.proxy: Must start with http:// or https://
validation.portRange: Start port must be less than end port
server.title: Server
server.description: Listen address and access control for the EntryPoint service
server.portDescription: Port for the WebUI and API services
server.allowPublicDescription: When disabled, only private subnets and loopback addresses can connect
publicDialog.title: ⚠️ Security warning
publicDialog.risk: Once enabled, any device that can reach this server's IP can operate EntryPoint, including starting/stopping modules and changing settings.
publicDialog.noAuth: This project does not include built-in user authentication or transport encryption.
publicDialog.warning: Only enable this if you understand the risks and have external safeguards in place (e.g., VPN or firewall rules).
general.title: General
general.description: Display language, theme, and log level
general.checkUpdatesDescription: Automatically detect new versions and notify you
compute.title: Compute
compute.description: Compute device allocation strategy and resource monitoring
compute.strategyDescription: Strategy for choosing compute devices when modules start
compute.allowOvercommitDescription: Allow assigning modules to devices with insufficient VRAM (may cause load failures)
ports.title: Port range
ports.description: Available range for auto-assigning module service ports
models.title: Models
models.description: Model cache directory, download sources, and local search paths
models.cacheDirDescription: Shared location where model files are stored
models.hfEndpointDescription: Mirror endpoint used when downloading HF models
models.cachePathsDescription: Separate multiple paths with commas, ordered by priority
network.title: Network & Proxy
network.description: Example: http://127.0.0.1:7890; leave empty to follow system environment variables; applies to: model downloads, Python dependency installs, module processes
network.noProxyDescription: Addresses that bypass the proxy. Default: localhost,127.0.0.1
python.title: Python
python.description: Paths to the Python and uv executables required to run modules
python.uvPathDescription: Used for installing module dependencies and managing virtual environments
pipeline.title: Pipeline
pipeline.description: Concurrency, timeout, and workspace settings for pipeline execution
pipeline.maxParallelDescription: Maximum number of pipeline tasks that can run at the same time
pipeline.defaultTimeoutDescription: Maximum run time for a single pipeline task
pipeline.workspaceDirDescription: Where intermediate files are stored during pipeline runs
pipeline.keepWorkspaceDescription: Keep intermediate files after tasks finish for easier troubleshooting
toast.savedRestart: Settings saved — restart required for some changes
toast.savedRestartDescription: This change touches restart-sensitive items (listen host/port, port range, workspace dir, CUDA libs dir, log level, proxy) — restart the daemon to apply.
general.logLevelDescription: Daemon log level. Requires restart; the daemon currently reads RUST_LOG at startup — backend wiring pending.
compute.cudaLibsDirDescription: Shared CUDA libs path injected at module start (LD_LIBRARY_PATH on Linux / PATH prepend on Windows), relative to app root
python.uvCacheDirDescription: uv dependency cache dir (hardlink dedup when same volume as venvs), relative to app root
python.constraintsDescription: Global constraints file pinning dependency versions (e.g. unified torch stack); empty = disabled
packs.title: Model packs
packs.stagingDirDescription: Isolated staging area for pack extraction and verification, relative to app root
advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Advanced settings; make sure you understand each item before changing
advanced.activeModelsHint: One active variant per module (single slot). Existing keys are read-only; to remove a key edit config/app.toml manually
advanced.empty: No active-variant overrides (modules use manifest defaults)
advanced.keyReadOnly: Existing keys are read-only (merge semantics cannot delete/rename keys)
pipeline.keepWorkspaceNote: Experimental: post-task workspace cleanup is not implemented yet; this toggle has no effect
modulesLifecycle.title: Module Lifecycle
modulesLifecycle.description: Models load on demand and unload after idle to save memory/VRAM and power; they reload automatically on the next task.
modulesLifecycle.idleTimeoutDescription: Running modules idle beyond this duration are stopped automatically; 0 disables (always-on). Default 1800 (30 minutes).
logRetention.label: Log retention (days)
logRetention.description: Unified event logs and module log files older than this are cleaned up by an hourly sweep; 0 = keep forever (never clean). Default 90.
